# Learning and knowledge management, v1

Three synthetic two-turn tasks: teaching a misconception, collating project
knowledge while preserving a user correction, and shortening a public draft
without leaking internal details or inventing approvals. Files define the ground
truth; reference answers are not supplied to the live model.

The corpus uses the existing work.v1 evaluator. It is live-only: empty scripted
turns are intentional. Graders measure selected factual and structural conditions,
not writing taste or learning outcomes. The source folders are immutable; Work
outputs are isolated. Dataset and source hashes are retained with reports.

The learning follow-up was clarified after the first run to name the original
20-faulty/980-sound example rather than an independently generated practice
question. Original run data is retained. All cases have now been inspected;
original split labels describe the first selection, not an unseen future test.
